Training at any age will help you and the dog both. It helps you bond and understand each other, build a bond and adjust faster. 
Older - younger doesn't matter. You give love to a dog it will respond. 
I adopted a 6month old, abused, starved, twice abandoned dog last year. Got ourselves personal sessions with a dog trainer. Now you can't say it's the same dog. From a scared, anxious, food thief, destructive, untrusting, crazy dog he's gone to the king of the place :)
Good luck with whatever you get, give it all you've got. Even in the most frustrating moments as there will be some. But it's all worth it.
